data_fields.name: aggregation_weight
data_fields.donor_constant: weight = 1 / (1 + distance^2) in OpenAL units; summed per sound per frame

data_fields.name: bed_stop_fade_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 per output sample (fast fade when a looping sound is not requested in a frame)

data_fields.name: crossfade_max_fade
data_fields.donor_constant: 65536 counter units; fade length = 65536 / rate samples

data_fields.name: music_fade_rate_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per output sample (about 65536 interleaved samples, about 0.74 s stereo at 44.1 kHz)

data_fields.name: location_music_track
data_fields.donor_constant: one MusicName per system (on entry) and per planet (on landing); '<ambient>' mission token resets to it

data_fields.name: listener_position
data_fields.donor_constant: centre of the screen (set each frame in Audio::Update)

best_idea: Merge identical cues that land in the same frame into one voice at their weighted centroid, and crossfade music and beds on a per-sample counter that starts at full weight on the outgoing track.
decision_why: The only mechanism in this batch that merges many identical hits into one voice and has a sample-accurate crossfade with a counter. Adapt because the donor has no per-sound cap (D1), merges only within one frame (D2), and overlaps bed switches (D3); the sketch adds the cap and the crossfade shape, and the note asks for a merge window and a level-matched switch.
acceptance: Three attackers hitting in the same frame make one hit cue, and a finisher on a fourth attacker in the next frame still plays (unit test); a zone change between two ambience beds crossfades over the zone's fade length with no silence gap and the summed gain stays at or below 1.0 (level test).
